set.body:
Outcome
Supply generic presentation capabilities required by Meridian while preserving ScalaDock's independent architecture and runtime floor.

Owned scope
modules/fx; modules/core presentation geometry only where necessary; tests; docs/styling.md; build/runtime lanes

Prerequisites
S1, S2, S3, S4, S5, S6

Acceptance criteria
- [ ] S1–S6 pass on an exact reviewed provider revision, including JDK22/JavaFX24 floor and JDK25/JavaFX27 runtime lanes.
- [ ] No AtlantaFX/Meridian dependency, theme-specific colors, scientific policy or new docking/persistence ownership enters ScalaDock.
- [ ] Existing public selectors and existing Custom(url) use remain supported or receive an explicit reviewed compatibility disposition; pane identity/persistence/close-admission behavior is preserved.
- [ ] Native custom schemes, live metrics/hit-tests, popup lifecycle, keyboard accessible actions and motion policy meet task acceptance.
- [ ] Provide a consumer-ready receipt to Meridian epic @R@ and local gate @B0@. Provider completion alone does not establish Meridian compatibility.

Required evidence
S6 independent review and exact-SHA provider receipt; no publication required.

Completion rule
Record exact candidate/revisions, commands and exit status, retained evidence paths, and applicable limitations. No unrun checks or browser-only captures establish native correctness. Keep provider/app ownership in its own tracker. Implementers reserve exact paths before editing; shared source files have one writer. Use review until the stated reviewer/gate accepts.

Plan
../meridianfx/PLAN.md — acceptance backlog code S. Mote is authoritative for status and dependencies.
set.title: [Meridian provider] Qualify generic theme, density and accessibility integration
